introduction: TennCare Connect is Tennessee’s health-coverage application route. Apply online, by telephone or on paper to have TennCare and relevant CoverKids eligibility assessed.
description: TennCare Connect is Tennessee’s health-coverage application route. Apply online, by telephone or on paper to have TennCare and relevant CoverKids eligibility assessed.

sections.who: The state uses coverage categories including children, caregivers, pregnancy, former foster care and age or disability circumstances. CoverKids has separate child and pregnancy-related categories.
sections.get: Approved health coverage depends on the category and plan. Read member information to understand providers and services.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Apply through TennCare Connect

    Use the application links or call 855-259-0701.

  2. Respond to the review

    Read letters requesting additional information and submit the specified records.

  3. Check each decision

    Review coverage dates and enrollment instructions for each applicant.
sections.after: Keep contact information current and follow renewals. Local health departments can provide in-person application help.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using TennCare intake and help, TennCare and CoverKids categories. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Yes. The state links English and Spanish forms and mail or fax submission instructions.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
